protocol_content.title: Near-infrared spectroscopy monitoring during cardiac surgery with cardiopulmonary bypass
protocol_content.research_question: Among adults undergoing cardiac surgery with cardiopulmonary bypass, compare near-infrared spectroscopy-guided monitoring with control care for postoperative delirium and the secondary outcomes defined by the Review.
protocol_content.review_criteria: Include randomized controlled trials of adults undergoing cardiac surgery with cardiopulmonary bypass that compare NIRS or cerebral-oximetry-guided monitoring with a control strategy and report postoperative delirium. Collect the postoperative outcomes specified by the Review using participant counts or reported means, standard deviations and group sizes.

result_targets.population: Adults undergoing cardiac surgery with cardiopulmonary bypass in randomized controlled trials.
result_targets.outcome_definition: Postoperative delirium diagnosed using the trial assessment method during the reported postoperative surveillance period.
result_targets.timepoint: Postoperative surveillance period defined by each eligible trial.
result_targets.analysis_population: Participants analyzed in the randomized groups for the selected outcome.
result_targets.selection_rule: Use the trial-defined randomized comparison and extract the reported participant-level count or final mean, standard deviation, and outcome-specific group size.
